decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension  would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbours' living conditions and preserve the character of the Conservation Area and it therefore complies with the adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENVB-2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-N 1.7 (Development near the Metropolitan Land Boundary), H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.30am to 5pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.30am to 12.00 noon on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house.
